studies.officialTitle: A Study of Orforglipron (LY3502970) in Participants With Obesity or Overweight With Weight-Related Comorbidities

design.description: Parallel-group oral-dose trial with lifestyle intervention.

studies.population: Adults with obesity, or overweight with at least one weight-related comorbidity, without diabetes.
studies.safetySummary: Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most common, were mainly mild to moderate, and treatment discontinuation increased with dose. Serious adverse events occurred in 3.8-5.5% of orforglipron arms vs. 4.9% with placebo. Per-arm nausea and vomiting incidence and anti-drug antibody data were not reported in the accessible main text (only in an inaccessible supplementary table).

sources.title: Orforglipron for the Treatment of Obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Study of Orforglipron in Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Type 2 Diabetes

design.description: Parallel-group oral-dose trial with lifestyle intervention.

studies.population: Adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes; weight management was an explicit objective.
studies.safetySummary: The safety profile was consistent with the GLP-1 receptor agonist class, with gastrointestinal adverse events most frequent. Serious adverse events occurred in 7.3-10.9% of orforglipron arms vs. 8.8% with placebo; nausea (20.1-36.4% vs. 8.4%) and vomiting (12.8-23.1% vs. 3.8%) were more common with orforglipron.
